## Relevant Symbols
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:372` — implement `blocked` with null `blocked_on` → `human:intake` (the incident's path)
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:373` — implement `failed` → `die`, phase kept
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:384-387` — plan `blocked` → question file from the summary, block kind (null → `human:intake`)
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:274-282` — the public-hostname rule (no IP, no internal suffixes, port 1..65535); inline today
- `hooks/session-launch.sh:294` — worker sandbox `network.allowedDomains` = the validated `allowed_domains`
- `hooks/hefesto-setup.sh:173` — setup puts `api.github.com` in `sandbox.network.deniedDomains` of `settings.local.json`
- `hooks/ledger.sh:575` — `blocked_on = {kind, since, question_path}`; no reason field today
- `hooks/ledger.sh:562-574` — `block` never replaces `human:intake`/`human:plan-approval`, and a worker never replaces any `human:*`
- `hooks/ledger.sh:590` — a worker can never clear a `stall`
- `hooks/ledger.sh:72` — `stall` is routed to the build pane by default (`PANES_DEFAULT`)
- `hooks/hefesto-setup.sh:238-297` — `--check` is read-only and accumulates `miss`; notes are plain `echo "setup: note: …"` (`:283`)
- `.claude/project-status.json` — tracked in git (`git ls-files`), the default board config

## Existing Patterns & Conventions
- Libraries are sourced with an existence check and a die naming the missing file (`hooks/ledger.sh:79-105`, `hooks/session-launch.sh:50-52`)
- Setup refuses with "(nothing was written)" when it stops before any write (`hooks/hefesto-setup.sh:66,183-184,359-361`)
- Files are written through a temp file and a `jq -e` validation, through a symlink with `cat >` (`hooks/hefesto-setup.sh:368-372`)
- What setup added is recorded in `env.HEFESTO_SETUP_EXTRA` / `HEFESTO_SETUP_SET` so `--remove` and the next run take out only its own (`:205-212`, `:326-349`)
- Smoke parts: `head_`, `ok`, `bad`, a `*_fail` flag; mutants by `sed` into a temp copy with a "mutant did not apply" guard (`tests/smoke-lane-cache.sh:116-123`)
- Untrusted text never becomes a command: item text and summaries are delimited DATA (`hooks/session-launch.sh:297`)
- Size: `ledger.sh` (926 lines) and `session-launch.sh` (704) are already past the 500-code-line limit; growth there gets an advisory (`.claude/rules/code-quality.md`), so new logic goes in a new sourced library

## Open Questions
- None blocking. Which of `sandbox.network.deniedDomains` (project `settings.local.json`) and the launcher's
  `--settings` `allowedDomains` wins for `api.github.com` in a worker is a Claude Code merge rule; the plan records
  it as a risk and requires only that `github.com` is reachable (spec D9).
